format: WSDC Registry Events, paper score sheet transfer

source.edition: Version 2026.1C (page footers; the file name says 2026.1B)
source.quote_free_summary: Transfer of judges' paper score sheet results to the computerized system is audited by the Chief Judge and/or an approved scoring team, verified by someone other than the person inputting.

requirement: A transcription correction (class a) is staged by the transcriber and verified by a different person against the retained paper original before it can be sent to the judge for confirmation.
interpretation_notes: Does not define a post-entry correction procedure; the Chief Judge role is not mapped to a DanceFlow role (OD-06 designations). Design only: nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed.
